gloss: street parking; parking on the road

definitions.gloss: street parking; parking on the road
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ} (parking on a public road). Often implies illegal or inconsiderate parking, though it can also refer to legitimate curbside parking.

examples.japanese: ここは{路駐|ろちゅう}{禁止|きんし}だ。
{路駐|ろちゅう}していたら{切符|きっぷ}を{切|き}られた。
examples.english: I got a parking ticket for parking on the street.

examples.japanese: この{通|とお}りは{路駐|ろちゅう}が{多|おお}くて{通|とお}りにくい。
examples.english: This street is hard to get through because there are so many cars parked on it.

notes:
USAGE:
{路駐|ろちゅう} is an informal abbreviation of {路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ} (on-street parking). It is commonly used in everyday conversation and often carries a negative nuance of illegal or nuisance parking.

GRAMMAR:
Can be used as a suru-verb: {路駐|ろちゅう}する (to park on the street).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路駐|ろちゅう}する (to park on the street)
- {路駐|ろちゅう}{禁止|きんし} (no street parking)
- {路駐|ろちゅう}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり (crackdown on illegal parking)
